items.title: Berlin’s Cygrid exits stealth with €2.66 million to stop AI agents from accessing confidential company data
items.summary: Cygrid, a Berlin-based cybersecurity startup, has exited stealth with a €2.66 million pre-Seed funding round for its identity-enforcement platform that controls access to confidential information. The funding round was led by Atlantic, the pan-European pre-Seed fund, with participation from D11Z.
